timeline.title: White's Relationship with Black Revealed
timeline.description: White does not hate Black despite recognizing him as a danger. He seeks to balance Black's freedom with the safety of the world.

timeline.title: Magenta's Future Discussed
timeline.description: The possibility of Magenta settling down romantically is addressed, emphasizing his nature as a Fragment.

timeline.title: Fragment Interaction with Black Explained
timeline.description: All Fragments can interact with Black, though most approach him cautiously. None hate him despite his destructive potential.

timeline.title: Fragment Immortality Explained
timeline.description: Fragments cannot normally be permanently killed by one another because death has been removed from their existence.

timeline.title: Favorite Foods Revealed
timeline.description: The favorite foods of numerous Fragments are publicly revealed.

timeline.title: Fusion Concept Introduced
timeline.description: The existence of Fragment fusion is officially explained. Multiple Fragments can merge into entirely new beings.

timeline.title: Grey Revealed
timeline.description: White and Black are confirmed capable of fusing into Grey, an incomplete physical manifestation of the Whole One.

timeline.title: Fragment Population Confirmed
timeline.description: The total number of Fragments is confirmed to be exactly twelve.

timeline.title: Ainul Explained
timeline.description: All Fragments fusing together always results in Ainul, the complete Whole One.

timeline.title: The Beast First Mentioned
timeline.description: A mysterious form known as The Beast is revealed to exist beyond ordinary Fragment states.

timeline.title: Magenta's Dancing Talent Revealed
timeline.description: Magenta is revealed to be one of the most skilled dancers among the Fragments.

timeline.title: Lavender's Gaming Ability Revealed
timeline.description: Lavender is shown to outperform Yellow in competitive gaming.

timeline.title: Official Top Five Power Ranking
timeline.description: Black, White, Taffy, Umbra and Cider are revealed as the five strongest Fragments.

timeline.title: Fragment Solidarity Explained
timeline.description: Hurting one Fragment is effectively hurting all of them due to their shared familial bond.

timeline.title: Red vs Blue Matchup Clarified
timeline.description: Despite elemental advantage, Blue is still unable to overcome Red's overwhelming raw power.

timeline.title: Rindo Preferences Revealed
timeline.description: Blue and Red are identified as the Fragments most likely to enjoy the Rindos.

timeline.title: Fragment Sparring Confirmed
timeline.description: Fragments sometimes engage in serious combat to settle disputes due to their inability to permanently kill one another.

timeline.title: Permanent Fragment Death Explained
timeline.description: Certain reality-defying entities and almighty beings are capable of permanently destroying Fragments.

timeline.title: Ainul's Unique Existence Clarified
timeline.description: A distinction is established between immortality and Ainul's state of being literally unable to die.

timeline.title: Fusion Memory Retention Revealed
timeline.description: Fragments retain memories and emotional bonds formed during Fusion.

timeline.title: Fusion Stability Explained
timeline.description: Fusions are not temporary and can exist indefinitely unless they willingly separate or experience severe internal conflict.

timeline.title: The Beast Revisited
timeline.description: The Beast is confirmed to be Ainul's equivalent of an Overclock state.

timeline.title: Overclock Power Clarified
timeline.description: An Overclocked Fragment can surpass multiple Dormant and even certain Awakened Fusions.

timeline.title: Fragment Animal Forms Mentioned
timeline.description: The concept of animal counterparts for Fragments is discussed but remains undeveloped.

timeline.title: Recursive Fusion Confirmed
timeline.description: Fusions are capable of fusing with other Fragments and Fusions. The final result remains identical regardless of fusion order.
